mode.title: Output Mode
mode.description: How this row writes data — File uploads mapped files as-is and writes mapped tables as CSV files; Worksheet writes one mapped table into an Excel worksheet.

helper_account_type.title: Helper Account Type
helper_account_type.description: Hidden helper: mirrors the root configuration's account.account_type so sibling fields below can depend on it (a row schema cannot reference the root config directly).

drive_id.title: Document Library
drive_id.description: Target document library (drive) for the upload

options.tooltip: Only applies to SharePoint accounts with more than one library. Leave empty to use the site's default document library.

folder_path.title: Folder Path
folder_path.description: Folder inside the library; missing folders are created automatically

options.tooltip: Relative to the library root. Supports the {{date}} placeholder, e.g. acme/reports/{{date}}/ — resolved at run start (UTC) by default, or use the Date field below (e.g. set Date to 'yesterday') to write into a different day's folder.

date.title: Date
date.description: Date used by the {{date}} placeholder in Folder Path

options.tooltip: Accepts a relative expression (yesterday, 3 days ago, last week) or an absolute date (2026-01-31). Leave empty to default to the job's start date (UTC).

conflict_behavior.title: Conflict Behavior
conflict_behavior.description: What to do when a file with the same name already exists

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: Name of the uploaded CSV file

options.tooltip: Only applies when exactly one table is mapped to this row. Defaults to the table's name with a .csv extension when left empty; leave empty when more than one table is mapped (each is then uploaded as '<table name>.csv'). Supports the {{date}} placeholder, resolved the same way as Folder Path's.

include_header.title: Include Header
include_header.description: Include the column header row in the uploaded file

path.title: Workbook Path
path.description: Path to the target workbook; created automatically when missing

options.tooltip: Accepts a library-relative path (/Reports/data.xlsx), drive://{driveId}/path, site://{siteName}/path, or an https:// sharing link. Use the search sync action to check whether it already exists.

drive_id.title: Library
drive_id.description: Document library of an existing workbook

options.tooltip: Pick the document library that contains the workbook, then pick the workbook itself below. For Private OneDrive/OneDrive for Business accounts this is always the account's own default drive.

file_id.title: Workbook
file_id.description: An existing workbook in the selected library

options.tooltip: Lists the XLSX files found in the Library selected above.

id.title: Worksheet ID
id.description: An existing worksheet in the workbook configured above

options.tooltip: Lists the worksheets found in the Workbook configured above.

name.title: Worksheet Name
name.description: Name of the target worksheet; created if it doesn't exist

options.tooltip: Selects the worksheet by name, creating it if it doesn't exist yet.

write_mode.title: Write Mode
write_mode.description: How the row's data is written into the worksheet

options.tooltip: Full Load clears the worksheet and rewrites it from cell A1. Append writes new rows below the existing data. Upsert matches rows by Key Columns below and updates them in place, appending any row whose key doesn't already exist.

key_columns.title: Key Columns
key_columns.description: Column names that identify a row for Upsert write mode

options.tooltip: Column names from the input table's header, e.g. id. Required when Write Mode is set to Upsert (Incremental).

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Number of rows written per Excel API request
